reviews.text: An exceptional veterinarian: professional, compassionate, dedicated to animal welfare, and highly competent. Thank you, Doctor, for everything you do.
Very good clinic, they treated my pet with great care and professionalism.

I would like to warmly thank Dr. Littner for the quality of his care and the treatment he gave my dog, Marcel.

I was very anxious about his symptoms, but Dr. Littner reassured me with his attentive listening, kindness, and professionalism.
Thank you, Madam, for your opinion.
Dr. Littner is very pleasant and competent. He took great care of my little Cavalier King Charles Spaniel. I highly recommend him.

So thankful for them. I had an emergency, my cat jumped off the 3rd floor and was bleeding from his face. I called and they were able to take me right away and spoke english. I was fully ready to use google translate but both the Vet and Vet tech were so helpful and kind. My cat is thankfully okay right now and in the midst of my own anxiety, they were both so helpful as I was about to pass out. My cat is doing good right now and with their follow up care and kindness, I am confident that my Camembert will be fine in no time. Windows will remain closed until further notice, but the cats are good!
Thank you for your help. This veterinarian shows a great deal of empathy and humanity. I highly recommend him.

A very good veterinarian who loves his job and animals.

Above all, he has excellent interpersonal skills.

Catastrophic. The vet was incredibly rude to his trainee in front of clients, and when he tried to vaccinate my kitten, he pierced its skin and had to start over. I never went back. Avoid at all costs.

Excellent veterinarian, very positive experience with Dr. Littner. He is a thorough, competent, and very welcoming doctor. The organization is perfect, and you feel completely at ease.

I recommend Dr. Littner without hesitation. He takes the time to explain things with great patience and kindness, which immediately puts you at ease. Thank you for your professionalism and for taking such good care of my baby, Zelda.

It took me a while to write this review because when I see how convinced people are, I think my message will be worthless... I'll try to keep it simple and short: One Saturday at 5 pm, I called to make an appointment because my cat wasn't urinating much and there was a little blood in the litter box. Dr. Litner told me, "It's an emergency for your cat, come in at 6 pm."
At 6 pm, I was seen by this doctor, who was, all things considered, kind and attentive (although...). Examination: the vet had barely touched his abdomen when my cat started hissing, spitting, scratching, biting... in short, he was thrashing around. The vet then told me that his bladder was enormous, probably due to stones or a urinary tract infection, but that he couldn't examine him further because he was too agitated, and that I had to catch him to put him back in his carrier so he could give him an injection. Examination complete, prescription for medication, new kibble and wet food, appointment for Monday at noon (hospitalization may be necessary if there's no improvement) with sedatives beforehand so he can be properly examined. Duration: 10 minutes, total cost: 250 euros... "Yes, ma'am, it's an emergency consultation, it's true that it's expensive."

I understood that it was a life-threatening emergency for the cat, but not an emergency consultation costing 150 euros... (approximately, if I deduct the price of the medication and food).

I was distraught by this price; I imagined the potential cost of hospitalization given the price of the consultation! I couldn't afford it... So I contacted another veterinarian, on Monday at 9 a.m. She told me to come at 2 p.m., to take away his kibble so he'd be fasting, and that she would give him a light anesthetic to examine him properly.

So, instead of going to Dr. Litner's appointment, I went to this vet. When I arrived, she took my cat, Horus, put him in a restraint net (he didn't even try to struggle), and off he went to sleep... She performed an ultrasound of his bladder, kidneys, and gallbladder. She cleaned his bladder (I don't know the exact term), analyzed the struvite stones, and did blood and urine tests. She trimmed his claws, cleaned his ears, and prescribed medication. I won't mention the price; you'd be surprised! Furthermore, she had the equipment to restrain and calm him so she could provide the necessary care, unlike Dr. Litner, who handed me a blanket so I could chase him and grab him!

In short, one consultation with her was enough to resolve the problem. With Dr. Litner, I would have surely needed two or three appointments at €250 each...

I wouldn't say she's incompetent; I don't think so. But perhaps we shouldn't treat all customers like walking wallets!

We were lucky enough to find Dr. Littner for our little Boston Terrier when we were living in Paris. Now, living in the suburbs, we continue to see him because he is an excellent professional: attentive, dedicated, offers sound advice, and is an excellent surgeon. The surgery for a tumor in her eye was a complete success, exceeding all our expectations. It's as if it had never happened. We are still very satisfied with all the care he has received. 🙏

Excellent clinic; Dr. Littner is very competent. He uses homeopathy in addition to medication.

He loves animals.
My cat, Othello, lived to be 19, including 5 years with kidney failure.

He treats my two cats, aged 14 and 8. I've been very satisfied for 25 years.
Excellent veterinarian, very attentive and meticulous. The quality of care is far superior to clinics because it's personalized and there's no pressure to perform. I recommend him without hesitation.

I highly recommend them. Our Pomeranian broke his leg and had to have surgery. Everything went very well. Excellent care, excellent follow-up… the vet was very thorough and concerned about the outcome and the dog's well-being.

A very positive experience at this clinic. My cat received excellent care and was treated with great attention by Dr. Littner. The diagnosis was quick. Thank you for your kindness and professionalism. I highly recommend them!
Poor handling of my cat, very disappointed and high price.
I was having trouble with my French bulldog, and Dr. Littner found the solution. I highly recommend him!

Professional physician with nice, English-speaking staff - will give your pet unnecessary and unwanted vaccines without your permission and then charge exorbitant fees for the drug. The clinic does not take payment from non-French Visa/Mastercards so you must be prepared to pay in cash if your credit card is tied to another European country, even if it’s in euros. They do not give accurate cost estimates up front so bring twice as much cash as they tell you to or you’ll be in trouble. Both my dogs have been here and the care is good but if you love your pet, they will take advantage of you. I simply can’t afford to go back and will have to look for a new vet now who does not charge for unapproved services.
An exceptional veterinarian, both for the quality of care and the welcoming atmosphere. A clinic where your animals are truly well cared for.

We were seen this morning by Dr. Littner and his young assistant (who was also very kind) for our 17-year-old baby's vaccination. He listened attentively, put us at ease, and was very pleasant. A fantastic vet; I recommend him 100,000%!

Dear Dr. Littner,
Thank you for the excellent care you have provided my cat over the past several years.
Thank you for your professionalism and dedication to his health.

Our cat has been seen by Dr. Littner for 17 years. He's a highly competent professional who listens to our concerns and is very diligent about vaccinations. We're very satisfied and continue to take our kitten to him for checkups. I highly recommend him!

I brought my elderly and very calm cat in, and everything went perfectly. Dr. Littner was gentle, professional, and very reassuring. My cat received excellent care. He gave great advice, and the service was truly top-notch.

I recommend him 100%!

I highly recommend this practice. We adopted a cat with multiple illnesses, including FIV, and after bad experiences at other practices, we finally found this doctor who listens, offers solutions, and is therefore reassuring!

Absolutely avoid this place!!!! SCAMMER!!!!

This so-called vet also sells medications, so he has every reason to SCAM you! Bill: 150 euros for a bird consultation

This so-called vet didn't examine my bird, constantly chatted with his submissive assistant about which medication had been brought in, didn't answer my questions about my pet's health, gave me antibiotics to administer myself because he didn't have the patience to give the injection himself, and asked me to "hold him myself"...

His assistant, equally incompetent except for his politeness on the phone when scheduling appointments (which is to be expected), also failed to restrain my bird, which panicked and ended up flying away and injuring itself on the windows...

I had to manage the situation while being yelled at by this so-called vet because, according to him, I was panicked and shouting too loudly...

Not to mention that he made me believe my pet was probably suffering from egg binding at 3 months old and that I needed to come back for an X-ray.

His His appointment book was empty, so he gave me an appointment date that suited me...

I cancelled because this Mr. Littner and his filthy practice, full of dusty lint and plants harmful to some animals, is an absolute disgrace to the veterinary profession!

AVOID AT ALL COSTS, and should even be reported to the Veterinary Board.

Excellent follow-up care for my little girl who suffers from severe gingivitis.

A big thank you to Dr. Littner and his assistant for the very empathetic care they provided.
I'm so glad I discovered this vet; my only regret is not having known about him sooner. My animals are doing wonderfully, go for it without hesitation! I recommend him 1000%, he's exceptional.
Excellent welcome and excellent care! A superb veterinarian.

We would like to sincerely thank Dr. Littner, who was with our little Yuki until his final moments. His attitude was one of great humanity and immense gentleness, both towards our pet and towards us.

During these difficult times, we truly appreciated his kindness, his attentiveness, and the delicate way in which he cared for our companion.
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your professionalism and empathy.

I want to express my sincere gratitude to Dr. Littner for his professionalism.

He has been treating my two cats for about eight months.
My first cat has suffered from feline herpesvirus (FHV-1) since she was a few months old, and no veterinarian before him had been able to cure her. He spayed her a few months later: a very clean and meticulous procedure.
She had an intestinal blockage this week, and thanks to his advice and care, she should be out of danger.
He is a competent veterinarian who genuinely cares about animal welfare.
It's true that the prices are sometimes a little higher than at other clinics; however, the quality of his work is quite different and significantly superior.
I prefer to pay a little more and have my cat safe and sound.

A very competent, available, and attentive doctor.

He saved our guinea pig, Midori, by optimizing treatment and managing the associated costs.

I highly recommend him.

A huge thank you to him!

For our other guinea pig, Yuki, the doctor demonstrated great attentiveness, understanding, and empathy, and gently accompanied him in his final moments.
We are very grateful for the quality of care provided, the accuracy of the diagnosis, and the doctor's understanding and compassion.
Thank you again!

We were seen by an efficient and empathetic veterinarian (who was very understanding with both the dog and its somewhat stressed owners) who was able to diagnose our Flat-Coated Retriever's eye.

We were seen at the clinic on a Sunday, 30 minutes after calling.

Thank you.
Mr. Littner was incredibly helpful, very kind to my cats, and took excellent care of them! I highly recommend him 👍 …
This clinic offers a warm welcome and prompt, efficient care. Having consulted there several times for emergencies that were treated without delay, I highly recommend this establishment!

Catastrophic experience!

I called this vet in an emergency because my kitten had just swallowed two small balls of yarn. Instead of asking basic questions about the animal's condition or calmly offering advice, he showed no empathy or consideration whatsoever. His only response was, "You have to bring him in tomorrow," without any explanation, without trying to understand the situation, and above all, without the slightest concern for the animal.

When I explained that I already had a vet appointment scheduled for the next day and that I was looking for immediate advice on what to do, he hung up on me abruptly, as if my request were worthless. Disrespectful, cold behavior, unworthy of a professional who is supposed to be there for animal welfare.

Frankly, when you choose a vet, you expect someone responsive, humane, and caring in an emergency. Here, it's the complete opposite: no listening, no respect, no professionalism.

👉 If you care about your animals and want to be taken seriously, absolutely avoid this vet. A waste of time, a total lack of compassion and interest.

_________________________________________________

Following your response, I would like to clarify a few important points:

Your response perfectly illustrates the problem I am denouncing.

Instead of acknowledging a complete lack of listening and empathy, you prefer to accuse clients of "hate" simply because they are sharing their experience.

I stand by my initial opinion word for word: I called for an emergency, I calmly explained the situation, and I was coldly told "you have to come tomorrow," without any questions, without any advice, before being hung up on. This isn't "nonsense," this is what actually happened.

When you choose to work with animals, you must also be able to show humanity and kindness.
Respect and listening cost nothing, but clearly, they aren't priorities at your clinic.

If you find this testimony unfair, perhaps you should reflect on your own actions rather than attacking those who simply had a bad experience. A little self-reflection would be far more helpful than responding with such contempt.

A competent and trustworthy veterinarian.

We've been going to Dr. Littner for almost five years for our cat, and long before that for two little rats. He has always been there for us, providing guidance and advice throughout our animals' lives, whether for minor ailments, vaccinations and boosters, or during more challenging times. A very professional doctor who truly loves animals.
Excellent veterinarian.

Thank you for your feedback.
The clinic assistant, on behalf of the entire team
Excellent service and very professional. My dog ​​was seen as an emergency and received prompt attention.
A very professional and welcoming veterinarian, not forgetting his assistants!

I brought my dog ​​to the clinic for a consultation. Mr. Littner is very attentive and warm. As a first-time pet owner, his help and advice were invaluable.

I highly recommend this clinic and extend my sincere thanks to Dr. Littner.

We had an emergency with our dog early in the evening, around 9 pm. We came here urgently because it was advertised as being open 24/7. But when we arrived, there was no one there. We called the number, no one answered, and we were never called back. We wasted another 15 minutes getting to the emergency room on the 3rd floor, while our dog was bleeding and in pain. We could have gotten there much faster if you had simply indicated that you were closed.

Excellent clinic!
My cat received excellent care; Dr. Littner is warm and professional.
I highly recommend them!

I have complete confidence in Dr. Littner, who has been treating my cat for kidney failure for many years. He is a very attentive and excellent professional, and he will take great care of your little companions! I recommend him without hesitation and thank him immensely. 🙏 …

The vet, Litnerr, is unpleasant and spoke to me aggressively. He didn't treat my cat well. His medications don't work. I've been to see him three times and I've had enough. And he charged me too much. He's desperate for money off animals he doesn't care about.
The vet, Litnner, saw my cat. He was verbally aggressive towards me and provided very poor care. I wonder if he has a psychological problem. On top of that, he charged me extra fees.

Another experience with Dr. Littner for my little Picasso. Just like last year with Zoé, Dr. Littner demonstrated great skill in quickly resolving an ataxia issue in our little companion. Once again, a big thank you to Dr. Littner for his prompt response.

A wonderful experience with Dr. Littner for our little Zoé!
After a fall from the fifth floor, Zoé miraculously survived. However, lameness and intestinal problems remained recurring.
After several consultations with different veterinarians, without any conclusive results, we decided to turn to homeopathy/osteopathy.
Today, after almost a month and a half of treatment and two mesotherapy sessions, Zoé is in excellent health.
A huge thank you to Dr. Littner for his skill, patience, and attentiveness, as well as to his assistant. We are deeply grateful for the care he provided, which has restored Zoé's independence. Another experience for my little Picasso in July 2025: Dr. Littner's great skill quickly resolved an "ataxia" problem in our little companion. Once again, a big thank you to Dr. Littner.

Mrs. Wiart/Mr. Laplace

Thank you so much, Dr. Littner! Thanks to your excellent care, Dashara (my 17-year-old cat) is doing much better: she no longer cries excessively and is peaceful again.

Dr. Littner is particularly welcoming and has extensive knowledge of veterinary homeopathy.

I highly recommend this veterinarian :)

I chose this veterinarian because he was close to home and had a good overall rating. The visit was for my puppy's puberty checkup and to inquire about necessary vaccinations before traveling abroad. While the initial phone contact was very reassuring, the consultation itself left me deeply uncomfortable and disappointed.

From the outset, the veterinarian seemed friendly, encouraging me to ask all my questions. But in reality, I felt judged and belittled. Every question I asked was met with very closed and unnuanced answers, leaving me with the impression of being ignorant or neglecting my pet.

Regarding the treatment, every problem raised seemed to immediately call for an expensive solution. My puppy had itching suspected of being caused by mange or parasites: two injections were administered without informing me of the cost beforehand (over €50 in total). It was only when the bill arrived that I discovered the price. This lack of transparency is, in my opinion, unacceptable.

The parasite control products offered were also excessively expensive, without any mention of more natural or affordable options. I would have liked to discuss alternative solutions or ask questions without feeling pressured or being made to feel guilty, like, "You don't have to take them... but anyway."

What also bothered me was the lack of introduction of the people present during the consultation. Two young people (probably students) observed without being introduced, which made my already unpleasant exchange even more uncomfortable. It seems to me that, out of simple respect, it would have been normal to introduce them.

I understand that veterinarians have valuable expertise, but listening, empathy, and education are also part of building a trusting relationship with pet owners, and that's not the impression I got.

If I could give zero stars… He interrupts me on the phone and asks, “What do you want?” when I’m calling to make an appointment. Then he calls me back, threatening to call the police?! Then he hangs up on me?! Who would leave their pet with this charlatan? I seriously question the pet owners who go to this clinic!
Excellent veterinarian, very professional and attentive, I highly recommend him, go for it!
Very good, quick and efficient service

Always delighted after a visit to Dr. Littner. The welcome, the attentive listening, the rapport with my animals, and the top-notch expertise. Thanks to his wise advice and care, my cats are in excellent health and… they keep coming back for more!

Dr. Littner treated my cat perfectly; he had been suffering from a bloody discharge from one of his eyes for several months. He not only treated the problem but also reassured me, which is no small thing. I highly recommend him.

A fantastic veterinary clinic!

The vet and his assistant are both lovely, caring, and passionate. My dog ​​and cat always receive excellent care there. You truly feel listened to, never left without an answer or support, even for the smallest questions. It's so reassuring to entrust your pets to people who love their work so much. I highly recommend them!

Thank you.
Best regards,
The clinic assistant on behalf of the entire team
Dr. Littner treated my cat very well, great clinic!

A loyal customer for 11 years…conscientious, always attentive, professional, and offering, within reason, a natural approach to both care and nutrition! He cured my dog ​​where two others had failed…I owe him my pet's 15 years and good health! And he travels all over Paris! 🙂 Thank you! …
